name: web3juice
description: Evidence-backed DeFi yield data: what ~17,000 pools pay, where the yield comes from and how it has moved.
long_description: Ask Claude what a stablecoin pays on each chain, how a pool's APY has moved over 90 days, or how a few pools compare. Every number is dated and linked to its source, base and reward-token yield are kept apart, and unknown values stay unknown. Read-only: Web3Juice never holds funds, never asks for keys and cannot sign transactions. Not financial advice.

api_key.title: Web3Juice API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty for the free research tools. Create a key at web3juice.com/?view=account for higher limits; Pro keys also let Claude read your saved alerts and notebook.

tools.name: summarize_yields
tools.description: Market overview for any filter: median and TVL-weighted APY by chain, protocol or strategy.

tools.name: search_pools
tools.description: Find and rank DeFi yield pools by token, chain, protocol, APY and TVL.

tools.name: get_pool
tools.description: One pool in detail: APY split, TVL, data age, addresses, deposit and source links.

tools.name: get_pool_history
tools.description: 7, 30 or 90-day APY trend with dated samples.

tools.name: compare_pools
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 pools side by side with 30-day ranges.

tools.name: get_data_sources
tools.description: Which feeds are used and when they last updated.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: How the experimental evidence assessment works.
